extension.summary: Duotone - every picture printed in its section's colour.
extension.description: A loud, graphic poster-design skin. Films are vermilion, series cobalt, music acid green: every image in a section is a one-colour print on a halftone field, and the focused item alone bursts into full colour. Giant condensed type, thick rules, a strict grid. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.11 - New Look setting (Skin settings, first row): Colour, Light or Dark. Light and Dark show every page in black and white; the focused picture still bursts into full colour. Also: Sets row in the Library panel; fix for controls disappearing with Reduce motion on.
